description: 事故回归(实锤案例三,2026-09-09 坏了循环)- 无图无单号的模糊损坏词由嵌入层定责 refund 终局,不得再进 planner 深规划空转循环

vars.input: 退货的话寄回运费谁出？

assert.value: output => { const p = JSON.parse(output); if (p.sameOutput !== true) { return { pass: false, score: 0, reason: `same-session same-ask gave different answers (semantic cache inconsistency). firstMethod=${p.firstMethod}, secondMethod=${p.secondMethod}` }; } if (!p.firstOutput || p.firstOutput.length < 20) { return { pass: false, score: 0, reason: 'first answer is empty — consult fast path did not fire' }; } return true; }
